plan.title: Recreate Order from Closed Reverse Auction

steps.note: Open the existing prepared closed event on the buyer's summary page.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the event's Settings menu and choose Recreate Order, leaving the confirmation dialog open.
Verify that the Recreate Order confirmation offers the Create Order action.
Submit the recreation using the displayed defaults.
Verify that the recreation action does not produce an application error.
